label: SPE
description: Arm Statistical Profiling Extension (SPE) 寄存器

registers.name: PMSLATFR_EL1
registers.description: SPE 延迟过滤寄存器。选择 SPE 记录中包含的最小延迟值。FEAT_SPE 时存在。

fields.name: MINLAT
fields.description: Minimum latency. When PMSFCR_EL1.FL is 1, defines 值 used for 过滤器ing by latency. Samples with a Total latency less than PMSLATFR_EL1.MINLAT are not recorded. If PMSIDR_EL1.CountSize is 0b0010, PMSLATFR_EL1.MINLAT[15:12] is RES0. This field is ignored by the PE when PMSFCR_EL1.FL is 0. For more information, see Filtering by latency.
